#Far girare il 20 del mese
from pyspark.sql.functions import * # collect_list, struct, explode, col,schema_of_json, from_json, to_json
from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient, BlobClient, ContainerClient
import datetime
import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql import Row
import pandas as pd
import json

# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

LinkedServiceNameBlobStorageCRM = 'crmpdatast'

current_date = datetime.datetime.now()

if current_date.month == 12:
    anno_calcolato = current_date.year + 1
    mese_calcolato = current_date.month + 1
else:
    anno_calcolato = current_date.year 
    mese_calcolato = current_date.month + 1  

anno = anno_calcolato
mese = mese_calcolato
anno_stringa=str(anno_calcolato)
mese_stringa=str(mese_calcolato).zfill(2)
nome="Modulo Commessa " + mese_stringa + "-" + anno_stringa

print("nome:", nome)


query_digitali=f"""(select MeseValidita, AnnoValidita, FkIdEnte, TotaleNotifichecategoria as totaleDigitali
                            from pfw.DatiModuloCommessaTotali 
                            where FkIdCategoriaSpedizione=2 
                            and MeseValidita={mese} 
                            and AnnoValidita={anno}) as digitali"""

spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_digitali, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("digitali")

query_analogiche=f"""(select MeseValidita, AnnoValidita, FkIdEnte, TotaleNotifichecategoria as totaleAnalogico
                            from pfw.DatiModuloCommessaTotali 
                            where FkIdCategoriaSpedizione=1 
                            and MeseValidita={mese} 
                            and AnnoValidita={anno}) as analogico"""

spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_analogiche, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("analogico")


query_all_enti=f"""(select distinct FkIdEnte from pfw.DatiModuloCommessaTotali) as allEnti"""

spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query_all_enti, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("allEnti")

pandas_df = spark.sql(f"""select '{nome}' as nome, '{anno}' as anno, '{mese}' as mese, 
                        aa.FkIdEnte as internalistitutionid, totaleAnalogico, totaleDigitali     
                        from allEnti aa
                        left join analogico a on aa.FkIdEnte=a.FkIdEnte
                        left join digitali d on aa.FkIdEnte=d.FkIdEnte
                        where a.AnnoValidita=d.AnnoValidita and d.MeseValidita=d.MeseValidita
                        and NVL(a.totaleAnalogico+d.totaleDigitali, 0) <> 0""")

json_rdd = pandas_df.toJSON().collect()  
json  = "[" + ",".join(json_rdd) + "]" 

display("Avvio il caricamento")

blob_name = "modulo_commessa_"+current_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M")+".json"
url = "https://crmpdatast.blob.core.windows.net"
shared_access_key = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(LinkedServiceNameBlobStorageCRM)
container_name = "data"

try:
    blob_service_client = BlobServiceClient(url, credential=shared_access_key)
    
    blob_client = blob_service_client.get_blob_client(container=container_name, blob=blob_name)
    
    blob_client.upload_blob(json, overwrite=True)
    
    print(f"I dati sono stati salvati con successo in {blob_name} nel container {container_name}.")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"Errore durante il caricamento di {blob_name}: {e}")
